title: Jaane Fatima Zainab Qalbe Murtaza Zainab
body:
JAAN-E-FATIMA ZAINAB QALB-E-MURTUZA ZAINAB
Bhai aur behen ne yuin haq adaa kiya milkar
Phirse is zamane ko ye batadiya milkar
Deen-e-Mustafa ooncha hashr tak kiya milkar
<<MINI>>
Haye is mahine mein kargayi qaza Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Bekajawa oonto par darbadar phiri Zainab
Karbala ki raho’n mein nange sar rahi Zainab
Haaye aisi zillath se kyun na mar gayi Zainab
<<MINI>>
Haye is mahine mein kargayi qaza Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Saath har qadam tune bhai ka diya Zainab
Tune deen ki khaatir ghar luta diya Zainab
Sar ghuroor-e-baatil ka phir jhukadiya Zainab
<<MINI>>
Haye is mahine mein kargayi qaza Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Phirse sham-o-koofa ka waqiya nazar aaya
Bhai ka wo latka sar shajr par nazar aaya
Har taraf bapa mehshar hashr ka nazar aaya
<<MINI>>
Haye is mahine mein kargayi qaza Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Zulm jo huwe tumpar kya bayaa’n kare Agha
Belche se zalim ne waar ek kiya aisa
Bekasi-o-ghurbat mein maut ka payaam aaya
<<MINI>>
Haye is mahine mein kargayi qaza Zainab
